business.signIn.steps.title: Setting up your sign-in
business.signIn.ready: Have ready: this phone, and an email address you can open now — the first time, we send a code to it to confirm it.
business.signIn.loginLede: With your phone number and your 5-digit PIN — the same PIN you use in every SeeBuyGet app you open with your phone number.
business.signIn.phoneLede: New here, on a new device, or forgot your PIN? We send a code to your phone to prove it is yours.
business.signIn.pinLede: Five digits you will remember and nobody else would guess. You sign in with it from now on.
business.signIn.emailTitle: An email for getting back in
business.signIn.emailLede: If you ever lose your phone number, this is how you get back into your account. We send a code to prove you read it.
business.signIn.samePin: Everyone in a business signs in as themselves. There is no shared company password.
business.activity.shipperSub: A manufacturer, distributor, trader or exporter with loads to move.
business.activity.importerSub: Containers and consignments arrive for us from abroad.
business.activity.expeditorSub: A freight forwarder: you book for the businesses you work for, as their agent.
business.activity.clearing_agentSub: Importers appoint you, share their papers with you, and you clear the goods.
business.activity.depotSub: Empty containers come and go through your gate.
business.activity.receiver: We receive goods at our own places
business.activity.receiverSub: A builder’s yard, a shop’s store room, a factory: your suppliers send to your places, and you see what is coming in.
business.role.ownerSub: Everything, including who is in the business and what it says about itself.
business.role.bookerSub: The day-to-day work: imports, papers, places.
business.role.financeSub: The same work as a booker, and the person your payments will be connected through.
business.new.title: Sign up your business
business.new.lede: It works as soon as it is saved. Add your registration certificate and your ID next, so SeeBuyGet can check it: until then it has no public page and is not listed.
business.new.name: Registered name
business.new.nameHint: As it is written on your registration certificate.
business.new.yourNameHint: What you do for the business is recorded under this name.
business.new.checkNote: Signing it up saves the business, with you as its owner, and it works from then on. Its registration certificate and your ID come next.
business.new.need.name: Give the registered name.
business.setup.title: Signing up your business
business.setup.saved: Saved with the business. Its name, its numbers and what it does can be changed later under Business details.
business.setup.activitiesLede: Tick every one that fits: it decides what the app offers you. You can change it later under Business details.
business.setup.youLede: You become its owner: you add the people who work with you, and say what each of them may do.
business.setup.certLede: The certificate from your company registry. SeeBuyGet checks the name and the number you gave against it.
business.setup.idLede: A passport or national ID of the person speaking for the business: you, if that is you.
business.setup.idKept: The file of the ID is deleted the moment SeeBuyGet staff decide on it, accepted or not. What is kept is the record that it was checked: by whom, and when.
business.setup.photoTip: Flat, in good light, with all four corners in view.
business.setup.replace: Not the right one? Add another in its place.
business.setup.later: Add it later from the start screen
business.setup.askLede: Two members of SeeBuyGet staff look at the papers, and you hear back by email. Once it is checked, the business has its own public page and is listed for others to find.
business.setup.askMissing: The check is made from both papers. Go back to add the one missing, or add it later from the start screen and ask there.
business.setup.askLater: Ask later from the start screen
business.setup.doneAsked: It works now. SeeBuyGet has your papers: two members of staff look at them, and you hear back by email. Until then it has no public page and is not listed.
business.setup.doneLater: It works now. Until SeeBuyGet has checked it, it has no public page and is not listed: add the papers and ask for the check on the start screen, under “SeeBuyGet’s check”.
business.home.step.papers: Add your registration certificate and the ID of the person speaking for the business. Two members of SeeBuyGet staff check them.
business.home.step.ask: Your papers are in. Ask SeeBuyGet to check the business.
business.home.step.waiting: SeeBuyGet has your papers. Two members of staff look at them, and you hear back by email.
business.home.step.refused: SeeBuyGet could not check the business yet. Put right what they said, then ask again.
business.home.step.done: Checked. Carriers and clearing agents see the business as checked, and it has its own public page.
business.home.asked: Asked. You will hear back by email.
business.home.ownerDoes: An owner of the business adds the papers and asks for the check.
business.home.go.imports: Containers on their way, their papers, and the agent clearing them.
business.home.go.clearing: Parcels from abroad at customs, where you clear
business.home.go.exports: Boxes leaving through a port: the road to the terminal before the gate closes, the weight, the papers, the file for your forwarder.
business.home.go.yard: Your yard’s register and what is on its way to it.
business.home.go.inbound: What your suppliers are sending to your places, and the codes they write.
business.home.go.people: Who is in the business, and what each person may do.
business.home.go.details: Your name, numbers, contact card and saved places.
business.paper.certHint: The certificate from your company registry.
business.paper.idHint: A passport or national ID of the person speaking for the business. Its file is deleted the moment SeeBuyGet staff decide on it.
business.contracts.title: Your carriers
business.contracts.lede: Fleets you have a contract with. A load you order with one of them goes straight to that fleet to plan — not onto the open board. The price and the terms stay on your own contract with them.
business.contracts.f.code: The code your carrier sent you
business.contracts.f.codeHint: Ten letters and numbers, from the fleet you have a contract with. It works once.
business.contracts.linked: Linked. Loads you order with {fleet} now go straight to them.
business.contracts.ownerOnly: An owner of the business links a contract with a carrier, or ends one.
business.contracts.offersLede: Hauliers you asked through the logistics directory recorded these contracts with you. Accept one, and the loads you order with that haulier go straight to it; decline it, and nothing is linked. Either way the haulier is told.
business.contracts.acceptedNote: You accepted the contract with {fleet}: loads you order with it go straight to it.
business.contracts.declinedNote: You declined the contract with {fleet}. It is told.
business.contracts.offerOwner: An owner accepts or declines a contract.
business.contracts.findLede: Hauliers in SeeBuyGet’s logistics directory: fleets our staff checked, in every country, in alphabetical order — each one’s own words beside what we have seen of its work. Ask one for a contract: it is told in its app, and when it agrees it records the contract and sends you a code to paste above.
business.contracts.findSearch: Search by name, country or words
business.contracts.findNone: No haulier is in the directory yet.
business.contracts.findSeen: {n, plural, one {# load delivered by its drivers on SeeBuyGet} other {# loads delivered by its drivers on SeeBuyGet}}.
business.contracts.findSeenNone: Nothing through SeeBuyGet yet — most of a fleet’s work never comes through us.
business.contracts.askedNote: {fleet} is asked. When it agrees, it sends you a code to paste above.
business.contracts.askOwner: An owner asks a haulier for a contract.
business.contracts.endHint: No new loads can be ordered under it. Loads already ordered are still delivered.
business.contracts.howTo: Your carrier records the contract in their fleet app and sends you a code. Paste it above.
business.loads.f.boardSub: Any checked carrier can take it, or send you a price.
business.loads.f.contractSub: Your contract carrier. It goes to their plan, at your contract price.
business.loads.f.deliverOnHint: {fleet} plans its trucks for each day from the orders it has.
business.loads.f.orderRefHint: Your carrier sees it, and the same number cannot be ordered twice.
business.loads.f.toReceiver: Deliver to another business, by the code it gave you
business.loads.f.deliverToHint: The business you are sending to gave you a code for its place. It sees this load coming, without your price.
business.loads.f.codeShape: A code is eight letters and numbers, like 7KQ3-PX9M.
business.loads.f.receiverRef: Their order number, if {name} gave you one
business.loads.f.receiverRefHint: They see it beside the load, so they know which order is coming.
business.loads.contractNote: Ordered under your contract: the price and how you pay are between you and the carrier. SeeBuyGet keeps the order, the consignment note and the tracking.
business.loads.newLedeContract: Where it is, where it goes, and what it is. Your carrier plans from exactly this, and it goes on the consignment note.
business.loads.loadOfFull: Load {no} of {of} of {order}. Your carrier brings this order ({kg} kg in all) in {of, plural, one {# delivery} other {# deliveries}}; each is signed for on its own.
business.door.title: At the door
business.door.why.absent: nobody was there to receive it
business.door.why.unreachable: the driver could not reach the place
business.door.add: Add a note for the driver
business.door.addBody: The driver who has it is told at once. What you said before stays.
business.door.changeBody: What the driver reads at the door. Rewritten until the goods are taken over; after that you add to it.
business.door.err.note: Write the note for the driver.
business.loads.win.lateFull: At the door about {at} on {day} — {by} after {asked}.
business.loads.win.earlyFull: At the door about {at} on {day} — {by} before {asked}: the day does not leave the vehicle room to wait.
business.loads.win.estimate: This is what your carrier’s plan for the day says. Its time is an estimate, and the day can still be planned again. If this cannot work, speak to {fleet} now.
business.loads.late.hour: it was planned for about {at} and has not been delivered
business.loads.late.hourFull: Running late: your carrier’s plan had it at the door about {at} on {day}, and it has not been delivered.
business.loads.late.day: it was ordered for {day} and has not been delivered
business.loads.late.dayFull: Late: it was ordered for {day} and has not been delivered.
business.loads.done.dayLate: handed over on {day}; it was ordered for {ordered}
business.loads.done.dayLateFull: Handed over at {at} on {day}. It was ordered for {ordered}.
business.loads.done.dayEarlyFull: Handed over at {at} on {day}, before the day it was ordered for ({ordered}).
business.loads.done.after: handed over at {at}, {by} after your window
business.loads.done.afterFull: Handed over at {at}, {by} after the window you asked for ({window}).
business.loads.done.before: handed over at {at}, {by} before your window
business.loads.done.beforeFull: Handed over at {at}, {by} before the window you asked for ({window}).
business.loads.done.inside: handed over at {at}, inside your window
business.loads.done.insideFull: Handed over at {at}, inside the window you asked for ({window}).
business.loads.done.clock: The time is on your carrier’s own clock, read when the load was handed over.
business.loads.left.room: your carrier’s plan for {day} has no room for it
business.loads.left.fit: no vehicle in your carrier’s plan for {day} can carry it as ordered
business.loads.left.heavy: it is heavier than your carrier’s largest vehicle carries
business.loads.left.place: the place it goes to has no point on the map, so it could not be planned
business.loads.left.closed: the place it is collected from is closed on {day} by the loading hours you keep for it
business.loads.left.today: it is for today and is on no vehicle yet
business.loads.left.todayFull: On no vehicle: it was ordered for {day}, the day’s work has begun, and your carrier has not put it on a vehicle.
business.loads.left.do: This is what your carrier’s plan for the day says, and the day can still be planned again. Speak to {fleet} now.
business.loads.left.doToday: No plan says this: it is in none your carrier has accepted for today, or it missed the trip it was planned on. It can still be planned, or put on a driver by hand. Speak to {fleet} now.
business.loads.plan.rowIn: planned for about {at}, inside your window
business.loads.plan.fullIn: At the door about {at} on {day}, inside the window you asked for ({window}).
business.loads.plan.estimate: This is what your carrier’s plan for the day says. Its time is an estimate, and the day can still be planned again.
business.home.go.loads: Post a load for carriers to take, and follow it to the door.
business.home.go.runs: Take space on a truck that is leaving anyway.
business.home.go.parcels: Send a parcel shop to shop, paid from your parcel balance.
business.home.go.contracts: The fleets you have a contract with, whose plan your orders go straight into.
business.loads.title: Loads
business.loads.lede: Post a load for carriers on the open board, agree a price, and follow it to the door. You pay the carrier yourself — SeeBuyGet keeps the record.
business.loads.newLede: Where it is, where it goes, and what it is. Carriers read exactly this on the board, and it goes on the consignment note.
business.reservations.title: What the driver noted at pickup
business.reservations.lede: It goes on the consignment note beside the goods. It binds you only if you agree to it; if you dispute it, say why — your words go on the note beside the driver’s. You answer once.
business.reservations.agreedDone: You agreed to the driver’s reservations. The consignment note says so.
business.reservations.disputedDone: Your dispute is on the consignment note beside the driver’s reservations.
business.loads.f.cover: The carrier must have insurance cover
business.loads.f.volume: Space it takes (m³), if it is light for its size
business.loads.f.volumeHint: For goods that fill a truck before they weigh it down. A vehicle whose fleet recorded a smaller load space is not offered it.
business.loads.f.truckFlight: Moved for an airline under its air waybill (a trucked flight)
business.loads.f.truckFlightHint: It is carried as an ordinary road load under the law of the road: the air waybill and the flight are a reference only, on the consignment note and told to the driver. Whether the air convention applies instead is not settled; nobody on SeeBuyGet acts for the airline.
business.loads.f.flightAirline: Airline, if its prefix is not known
business.loads.f.noTranshipmentHint: The goods stay on the vehicle that took them over. On the consignment note; a reload after a breakdown is written there against it.
business.loads.f.declaredHint: A value you declare raises what the carrier answers for if the goods are lost or damaged; a carrier may charge for it, so agree it with them. Both go on the consignment note.
business.loads.need.valueCurrency: Choose the money the value is in
business.loads.f.coverHint: Only a carrier whose insurance SeeBuyGet has checked off its policy, and which is still running, can take it. Fewer carriers may answer; the consignment note names the cover.
business.details.addressHint: The sender’s address on your consignment notes.
business.details.addressNone: Not given — your consignment notes say the address is not recorded
business.loads.f.consigneeHint: The consignee on the consignment note.
business.loads.f.consigneeHintCrossing: Across a border the consignment note names who receives the goods, and their address.
business.loads.f.dangerousHint: Give the UN number, the proper shipping name and the class as their safety data sheet names them: the consignment note prints them. Yours to give — SeeBuyGet classifies nothing.
business.loads.f.customsPlaceholder: Where it is cleared, and by whom
business.loads.need.packages: Say how many packages — or pack it loose
business.loads.need.unNumber: Give the UN number: four digits, as on the safety data sheet
business.loads.f.pickupOnHint: Empty means as soon as a carrier can.
business.loads.f.negotiate: Carriers name their price, and I choose
business.loads.f.negotiateSub: Nobody takes it until you accept a price.
business.loads.f.instant: The first carrier at the board price takes it
business.loads.f.instantSub: Quicker. The price is the board’s own for this distance and load.
business.loads.settleNote: You pay the carrier directly, or through your own payment system. SeeBuyGet does not take, hold or send the money — it keeps the price, the carrier’s invoice and whether it is paid.
business.loads.placeGone: One of those places could not be found any more. Choose it again.
business.loads.notYours: The load this notice is about is not among this business’s loads.
business.runs.notYours: The booking this notice is about is not among this business’s bookings.
business.exports.notYours: The export this notice is about is not among this business’s exports.
business.linked.notHere: What this notice is about is not among this business’s records.
business.loads.fact.keptOwn: as you gave it — only a refrigerated or insulated truck takes it, and the driver logs the temperature.
business.loads.fact.keptUsual: the usual for chilled goods: you gave no range of your own.
business.seals.title: Seals
business.seals.hint: Written before pickup; the driver reads each off the door, and the load does not leave on a number that is not the one written.
business.seals.requiredCrossBorder: A seal is required: {company} requires one on loads that cross a border. Write it before pickup — the goods are not taken over without it.
business.seals.requiredContainer: A seal is required: {company} requires one on container legs. Write it before pickup — the goods are not taken over without it.
business.seals.noneYetRequired: No seal written yet. Write it here before pickup.
business.seals.noneYet: No seal written. A seal is not required; where you seal the load, write each one here before pickup.
business.seals.number: Its number, as printed on it
business.seals.photosHint: Three photographs, taken as you seal it: they are the record anybody who later reads the seal holds it against.
business.seals.photo.loadedOpen: The load open, blocked and braced
business.seals.photo.closedWithSeal: Closed: the vehicle’s or container’s number and the seal in view
business.seals.photo.sealCloseUp: The seal close up, its whole number readable
business.seals.photoFailed: The photograph did not go: try again where there is a signal.
business.paid.head: Paying the driver
business.claim.title: A problem with the goods
business.claim.lede: Something wrong with what was delivered? Report it here. SeeBuyGet does not judge a claim: what you write goes onto the consignment note, frozen as the damage claim report, for you to hand to the carrier or your insurer.
business.claim.open: Report a problem with the goods
business.claim.body: {code} was delivered. Say what you found, with a photo if you have one. Unless a company of SeeBuyGet stated cover for this load, nobody of the network decides it or pays: the note, frozen with your claim on it, is the report.
